disposition: vehicle yielded; channel returned to normal traffic
summary: A unit broadcast a Code 33, clearing the radio channel for emergency traffic, as officers went after a vehicle they said appeared to be yielding. The stop was reported on Hampton Avenue, with a second block location given moments later, and multiple units were en route before the code was cleared.

area: Goode Park on Hawthorne Avenue, Bakersfield
disposition: medic rolled; engine sent to an updated address on Hawthorne
summary: Officers and Liberty Ambulance paramedics were sent to a park on Hawthorne Avenue for a possible assault victim. Dispatch described a man in a black shirt and blue jeans with facial injuries who said he had been jumped and was last seen walking eastbound on Hawthorne from the park. An engine was cleared into an updated address on Hawthorne a few minutes later.

disposition: downgraded to a code 2 response; remaining companies handling
summary: Battalion 6 was sent to a refuse fire burning inside a decommissioned tank that crews recognized as one previously used to burn copper wire. The battalion downgraded the assignment, kept the fire with the companies already on scene and advised when they arrived.
Officers were sent to an apartment after a caller reported that a man and a woman were taking boards off the place and entering the residence.

area: 8100 block of East Brundage Lane, Bakersfield
disposition: officers sent; subjects possibly tied to an earlier vandalism report
summary: Officers were sent for a prowler report at a car wash on East Brundage Lane after an initial report of a nearby business. Dispatch gave descriptions of a woman in a tie-dye shirt and black shorts and a man in a hunter-green ball cap, green shirt and blue jeans in front of the business along a weed patch sign, and noted they could be connected to an earlier vandalism report.
A caller asked officers to check on a family member at a Smith Street block residence.
Officers were sent to a verbal disturbance involving an ex-boyfriend who was refusing to leave and was described as being with a white Toyota pickup.

area: east of Haley Street and Panorama Drive, Bakersfield
summary: Security reported a woman in her mid-twenties who was belligerent and battering her friend near Haley Street and Panorama Drive.

disposition: CHP requested for a tire change
summary: A semi was reported on the right-hand shoulder and CHP was requested to handle a tire change.

disposition: deputies asked to check on the juvenile
summary: A caller reported that a juvenile had texted about an argument with her boyfriend and said she was going to harm herself. Deputies were asked to check on her.

area: Union Avenue at Panama Road, Bakersfield
summary: Officers stopped a pickup at Union Avenue and Panama Road and took the driver into custody.
Units were sent to a domestic disturbance in the north part of the city.

disposition: officers sent to check on the resident
summary: Officers were sent to check the welfare of a First Street block resident who was described as having made statements about harming herself.
An ambulance was sent for a juvenile patient who was unconscious but breathing after taking medication.

disposition: crews sent to the alarm; station assigned to a lift assist
summary: Crews were sent to an audible alarm at a residence, and a station was sent to a business on Wilson Road to assist with a lift assist.
An ambulance was sent to an apartment for a patient having difficulty breathing.
A caller asked officers to check on someone at a Union Avenue block address.
An ambulance was sent to an apartment for a patient with abdominal pain.
A caller asked officers to check on a neighbor at a Fremont Street block address.
